title: Augmented increasing-tuple sheaf complex with affine section comparison
statement: Let $A,B$ be commutative rings, $X$ a scheme, $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ separated, $g:\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}A$, and $p:X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\operatorname{Spec}B\to X$ the projection [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let $U:\operatorname{Fin}(r)\to X.\mathrm{Opens}$ be a finite affine open cover, including $r=0$, and $G$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module. Suppose the tensor pullback $p^*$ [def-pc-module-pullback] is additive. There exist a nonnegative cochain complex $C$ of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] and $\epsilon:G[0]\to C$ such that: (1) $f_*(\operatorname{extend}C)$ is isomorphic as an integer cochain complex to the explicit affine alternating section model [def-pc-affine-alternating-cech-model]; (2) $\epsilon$ and $p^*(\operatorname{extend}\epsilon)$ are quasi-isomorphisms; (3) for every $k\in\mathbb N$ there are $n\in\mathbb N$ and affine opens $W_j\subseteq X$, $j\in\operatorname{Fin}(n)$, such that $C^k\cong\prod_j (W_j\hookrightarrow X)_*(G|_{W_j})$. The empty product is permitted. No derived functor or derived-unit assertion is included.

proof.text: Use the explicitly constructed increasing-tuple complex and restriction augmentation. Apply the local contraction theorem to the base-change projection, and the affine comparison theorem to f.

The tuple-indexed term comparison gives products of open direct images. Since f is separated and Spec A is affine, X is separated; each finite nonempty tuple intersection is affine. Enumerate the finite tuple type by Fin of its cardinality, and reindex the product along this equivalence to obtain the required W and n. This works for empty tuple types as well.
